title: Reporting Regulatory Mandates
goal: Report present and past institutional mandates using exigir/ordenar/pedir/recomendar que + passive se + subjunctive.

items: I can report standing regulatory mandates (*exige que se audite*) and past rulings (*ordenó que se auditaran*) with passive *se*.
I can maintain tense sequence and plural agreement inside reported institutional demands.
I can use key terms for algorithmic audits, regulatory frameworks, cybersecurity, human oversight and tech regulation.
